title: Renewal Offer Acceptance on Residential Electricity Supply Agreements
content:
**Rule.** A customer renews a Residential Electricity Supply agreement by accepting the offer stated in the governing renewal notice: the agreement takes the offered plan and that plan's term, at the renewal rate determined for that agreement rather than the bare offered rate.

The renewal rate is fixed only after the agreement's bill lines carry the dual-fuel credit owed for every billing cycle within the billing dispute lookback on whose start date a Beacon Ridge gas agreement on the same premise was active.

**Business effect.** An accepted renewal moves the agreement onto the accepted plan for a new fixed term: its plan, term length, contract rate, the start date of the new term and the new contract end date are replaced, and the agreement stays active. The start of the new term is then the agreement's latest renewal or plan change date.

## Acceptance action

**Capability.** `accept_renewal_offer_e5d86473` records the account holder's personal acceptance of the renewal offer on one of their Beacon Ridge residential electricity agreements. The plan name, term length, contract rate, start date of the new term and new contract end date on the agreement are replaced by the values given, and the agreement stays active.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool: the care agent unlocks `accept_renewal_offer_e5d86473` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to accept.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `power_agreement_id` | The residential electricity agreement number being renewed, as read from the agreement lookup for the caller's premise | Identifier |
| `variant_name` | The official name of the plan accepted for the new term | Exactly one of: `Beacon Ridge Monthly Variable`, `Beacon Ridge Price Lock 6`, `Beacon Ridge Price Lock 12`, `Beacon Ridge Price Lock 24`, `Beacon Ridge Free Nights 12`, `Beacon Ridge Clean Wind 12`, `Beacon Ridge Clean Wind 24` |
| `term_months` | Length of the new term | Whole number of months, no decimals |
| `contract_rate_cents_kwh` | The supply rate of the new term | Cents per kWh to 2 decimal places (for example 10.25), no currency sign |
| `plan_change_date` | The first day of the new term | Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD |
| `contract_end_date` | The last day of the new term | Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD |

The plan names correspond to the month-to-month variable plan, the six-, twelve- and twenty-four-month price locks, the twelve-month time-of-use plan with free nights, and the twelve- and twenty-four-month wind-matched plans.

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the agreement number, the plan accepted, the rate in cents per kWh, and the new term's start and end dates. Receiving it means the acceptance is recorded on the agreement.
